name: Improved Response
body:
Discipline: psychoportation [Network]; Level: Tactician 3

MANIFESTING

Display: mental, visual
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: 1 creature
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless); Power Resistance: Yes (harmless)
Power Points: 5

DESCRIPTION

You accelerate the reaction time of the target, allowing them to take this round’s actions ahead of the creature who would have otherwise gone immediately before the target. If this would place the target before you and he has not already taken this round’s actions, the target must immediately take this round’s actions. If the target has already taken this round’s actions, the power affects them on the next round.

A creature may only be affected by this power once per round. This power does not allow a creature to act in a round if he would not normally be allowed to (such as during the surprise round).

Augment: For every additional 6 power points spent, the target’s place in the initiative order is improved by one additional step.
